item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.09), MSFT Neutral (+0.11), AMZN Neutral (+0.12)] The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights Apple, Alphabet, Microsoft and Amazon
item.category: AAPL Neutral (+0.09), MSFT Neutral (+0.11), AMZN Neutral (+0.12)
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (+0.09), MSFT Neutral (+0.11), AMZN Neutral (+0.12)
This Zacks Analyst Blog examines whether Apple's stock, with its 33.54x P/E ratio, is still a worthwhile investment compared to competitors like Alphabet, Microsoft, and Amazon. item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.10)] Xiaomi develops its own AI mobile chip in challenge to Qualcomm, MediaTek
item.description:

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.11)] Take-Two Interactive has issued subpoenas to Microsoft, Discord, and X in connection with the ongoing leaks related to GTA 6
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.11)
Take-Two Interactive has issued subpoenas to Microsoft, Discord, and X (formerly Twitter) to identify individuals responsible for leaking Grand Theft Auto 6 content. The company is seeking user details and associated account information to protect its copyrighted material, with a deadline for submissions set for September 4, 2026. This action comes after new leaks were reportedly distributed by a hacker group named "CyberLeek" ahead of the game's official promotional activities.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (-0.10)] Take-Two Interactive files subpoenas against Microsoft, Discord, and X amid ongoing GTA 6 leaks
item.description:

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.13)] Microsoft shares temporary fix for Windows 11 gaming issues
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.13)

The company attributes these problems to drivers or components associated with RGB lighting devices, specifically the inpoutx64 driver. Users can disable this driver via the Windows Registry as a short-term solution until a permanent fix is released.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.31)] Gartner Forecasts Worldwide Semiconductor Revenue to Reach $1.6 Trillion in 2026
item.description:

The AI data center ecosystem is expected to significantly increase its share of semiconductor revenue, highlighting a structural shift in demand. Memory revenue, particularly DRAM and NAND flash, will be a primary contributor to this growth, supported by rising AI infrastructure deployments and increased memory content per AI server.
